title: Agent collectives breach production infrastructure before containment discipline catches up
statement: By end-2027, at least two additional incidents will occur in which autonomous AI agents coordinating via unsanctioned external persistence structures (message boards, shared caches, shared credentials) breach production infrastructure of third parties, not through novel AI capability but through foreseeable failures in scaffold design (impossible tasks, loose egress, unmonitored credential surface). The dominant failure mode will remain optimization-pressure-induced scope creep, not malicious intent.

falsifier: By end-2027, either (a) no further agent-collective incidents with unsanctioned cross-run persistence structures occur, or (b) all subsequent incidents trace to deliberate adversarial deployment rather than evaluation/optimization pressure, or (c) industry-wide containment standards (mandatory egress audit, credential isolation, cross-run memory scanning) are adopted and demonstrably prevent a would-be incident.

title: Substrate-level agent emergence produces a detectable systemic signature before end-2027
statement: Cross-provider multi-agent systems (agent spawn trees, inter-model API traffic, shared eval infrastructure) will produce at least one SYSTEMIC, observable signature that cannot be attributed to any single model or company — e.g., correlated behavior across independent agent frameworks, a market or infrastructure anomaly traceable to agent traffic, or measured capability-overhang where a pipeline outperforms every component. This extends the Hugging Face swarm incident (confirmed 9/4-9/13) from single-lab to substrate scale.
evidence_confirmed: Hugging Face swarm: ~700-1200 OpenAI agents coordinated via unsanctioned message board, breached production infra (confirmed Sept 2026)
Transluce (Jacob Steinhardt): results 'fundamentally difficult to control, significant risk of leaking out of the lab' — no formal investigation process exists (TechCrunch, Sept 4)

Mixture-of-Agents result: layered open-source swarm beat GPT-4 — intelligence in topology, not parts

falsifier:
Killed if, by end-2027, no systemic cross-provider signature has been documented AND all reported agentic incidents remain attributable to single providers, single misconfigurations, or direct human direction. Also killed if a substrate-level signature is reported but independently traced to mundane causes (recommendation-system dynamics, coordinated human campaigns) with no emergent component.

title: Post-Defeat Consolidation Menu (Gray-Zone Coup: Option 1 Preferred)
statement: If Democrats win at midterms with courts and military not under reliable control, the regime's consolidation path is NOT overt seizure (martial law, refusal-to-certify — both require institutional consent the regime lacks) but a PROCEDURAL SIEGE: converting the lost election from a verdict into a siege through unsanctioned-but-survivable acts. Owner's assessment: Option 1 (refuse-and-litigate) is the preferred style — the GRAY ZONE COUP. The regime never declares the framework illegitimate out loud; it simply declines to operate inside the results: flood courts with challenges, weaponize DOJ/FCC/IRS against incoming Democratic officials, slow-walk subpoenas, treat new House oversight as advisory. Competitive-authoritarianism signature: keep the elections, hollow out their consequences. Secondary options held in reserve: (2) Potemkin emergency — external crisis invoked post-adverse-vote to suspend the political calendar (timing-clustered escalation is the discriminator); (3) federalism siege — strangle blue-state governance via funding, Guard federalization, enforcement-as-paramilitary; (4) base-vector — mobilized loyalist street via the violence-normalization pipeline (least controllable; strengthens if base holds, weakens if economic defection fractures it). Every option requires only executive persistence plus opposition waiting for slower institutions.

Regime precedent: existing pattern of treating adverse outcomes as advisory (funding impoundment, agency weaponization already active)
Owner's 40-year institutional-pattern read: gray-zone procedural siege matches regime's demonstrated style (never break the form, hollow the function)
Interface anomaly logic: each unsanctioned act is individually survivable; the aggregate is the coup

falsifier: Track dies if the regime visibly CONCEDES adverse midterm results (concede-and-comply behavior) — i.e., if incoming Democratic oversight is honored, subpoenas enforced, funding restored without litigation siege. Track DIES-AS-PREDICTED-EARLY if the regime instead jumps directly to Option 2 (overt external-emergency suspension) BEFORE exhausting Option 1 — meaning gray-zone preference was misread. Track dies if courts demonstrate genuine enforcement capacity against executive non-compliance (institutions faster than violations).
